_about: F2 the Hub's milestones (Satisfactory-style): hand in each milestone's parts at the Hub (from your pockets or a storage crate within deliver_range of it) and it unlocks its pieces. A tier opens once every milestone of the tier before is done; tier 1 is open from the start. Pieces no milestone unlocks can always be built. The final milestone unlocks the radio mast: start its rescue broadcast between broadcast_from and midnight, keep the mast standing and yourself alive until rescue_hour, and help comes.

salvage_rig.name: Salvage rig
salvage_rig.blurb: Machines that work the scrap heaps and wells out in the world.

lumber_yard.name: Lumber yard
lumber_yard.blurb: A portable bandsaw mill for the timber stands in the woods.

fuel_line.name: Fuel line
fuel_line.blurb: Gas from the crashed tankers, and power from the sun.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.blurb: Clean water and canned food that keep.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.blurb: Turrets that shoot nails, fed by hand, belt or hopper, with sensors and lights.

logistics.name: Logistics
logistics.blurb: Splitters and mergers: share one belt between machines, or join belts into one.

heavy_defense.name: Heavy defense
heavy_defense.blurb: Crossbow and rifle turrets, an electric fence, a repair station and noise tricks.

rescue_signal.name: Rescue signal
rescue_signal.blurb: A radio mast to call for rescue. Broadcast one night, keep it standing, and help comes at dawn. Every zombie for miles will hear it.
